questions.question: Describe a time you drank an herbal tea you liked.​​You should say:​What the tea was​Whom you drank it with​What the occasion was​​And explain how you felt about the experience.​

answers.label: Answer
answers.english: I've never been a huge fan of tea and I don't drink it a lot, but there was one occasion that left a huge impression on me. It was when I got invited to a tearoom by my friends and they ordered me this Chinese herbal tea that had flower petals in it. I think it was a mixture between raspberry and blueberry flavours or something, but dear me that was the best cup of tea I have ever had in my life, even to the point where I started feeling like a British for a second. The taste that it left in my mouth after I drank it was so special. It was sweet and so easy on the taste buds - such a good experience for the senses. Another reason why I liked it so much was because of the tea room itself. The room had an atmosphere that was really calm and peaceful. I felt like I didn't have to rush and could just enjoy every single second there. It helped me forget about all the worrying things that I had on my mind at the time. Overall, a very memorable experience.
